Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.Query → Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.Extension → Prop := fun query extension => extension.identity = query.identity ∧ extension.startPoint = query.start ∧ query.start.height ≤ query.target.height ∧ extension.endPoint.height = Min.min (query.start.height + Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.maxSuffix) query.target.height ∧ extension.suffix.length = extension.endPoint.height - extension.startPoint.height ∧ extension.suffix.length ≤ Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.maxSuffix ∧ extension.complete = Decidable.decide (extension.endPoint.height = query.target.height) ∧ (extension.endPoint.height = query.target.height → extension.endPoint.worldRoot = query.target.worldRoot) ∧ (extension.startPoint.height = extension.endPoint.height → extension.startPoint = extension.endPoint) ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.chainAfterDigests extension.startChain extension.suffix = extension.endChain ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.opens extension.startPoint extension.startChain extension.fromSiblings = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.opens extension.endPoint extension.endChain extension.toSiblings = Bool.true

∀ (query : Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.Query) (extension : Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.Extension), Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.verify query extension = Except.ok extension.endPoint → extension.startPoint = query.start ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.chainAfterDigests extension.startChain extension.suffix = extension.endChain ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.opens extension.startPoint extension.startChain extension.fromSiblings = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.opens extension.endPoint extension.endChain extension.toSiblings = Bool.true

∀ (query : Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.Query) (extension : Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.Extension), query.target.height < query.start.height → Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.verify query extension = Except.error "receipt continuity refused: identity, height, root, suffix or system opening differs"

∀ (point : Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.Point) (chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (siblings : List Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (world : Minidregg.Theory.AuthMap.Map Minidregg.Kernel.WorldRoot.Key Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest), point.worldRoot = Minidregg.Kernel.WorldRoot.deployed.root world → Minidregg.Kernel.WorldRoot.deployed.PathBinding world Minidregg.Kernel.WorldRoot.Key.system (Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.systemLeaf point.height chain)) { occupant := Option.none, siblings := siblings } → Minidregg.Kernel.ReceiptContinuity.opens point chain siblings = Bool.true → Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.systemLeaf point.height chain) = Minidregg.Theory.AuthMap.lookup Minidregg.Kernel.WorldRoot.deployed.ix world Minidregg.Kernel.WorldRoot.Key.system
